_comment: Claude Desktop configuration for WorldDriver. Copy this into your Claude Desktop config file: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS), %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows), or ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Linux). Claude Desktop's local-server schema is stdio-based, so mcp-remote bridges it to the mod's HTTP endpoint.
_port: 39800 is what the Fabric development runs pin the MCP port to. The NeoForge runs do not pin it; there, launch with -Dworlddriver.mcpPort=39800 or read the port from <loader>/run/worlddriver-mcp.port and edit the URL below to match. A configuration file cannot read a port file, so pin the port before relying on this.
_usage: Start the game with ./gradlew :fabric:runClient, then restart Claude Desktop. See docs/guide/mcp-clients.md.
